C0485.title: Game Company Fined for Selling Verified Accounts to Help Minors Bypass Anti-Addiction System
C0485.summary: A game company sold pre-verified adult accounts to minors through e-commerce platforms, providing virtual phone numbers and verification code receiving services to bypass secondary authentication and systematically circumvent anti-addiction mechanisms. The court ruled this as unfair competition that disrupted market order, resulting in an 800,000 yuan fine.

references.title: Gaming company fined 800,000 after investigation for helping minors bypass anti-addiction detection
